scripts.build: pnpm lint && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir apps/web exec vite build
scripts.lint: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/content/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.test: pnpm exec vitest run packages/shared packages/content apps/web && node --test scripts/export-android-artifacts.test.mjs
scripts.coverage: pnpm exec vitest run packages/shared packages/content apps/web --coverage
scripts.e2e: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.android:build: pnpm android:sync && node scripts/android-gradle.mjs clean assembleDebug && node scripts/export-android-artifacts.mjs debug
scripts.android:release: pnpm android:sync && node scripts/android-gradle.mjs clean assembleRelease bundleRelease && node scripts/export-android-artifacts.mjs release
